findings.issue: GI bleeding now cross-supported and cirrhosis population fixed, but neurologic/urgent cirrhosis actions remain single-source; introductory sudden mental-status action still broader.
findings.resolution: Keep actions; add precise independent general-neurologic/cirrhosis care source or narrow intro to the actual scoped bullets.

findings.issue: Drug information is now materially richer and no new gross factual contradiction found, but precise subclaims are not all independently cross-supported. Shared sponsor labels are not two independent authors merely because FDA/EMA host them.
findings.resolution: Use per-claim notes: split verified portions; obtain independent authored support for the remaining exact risk/indication/pregnancy conditions. Do not flatten FDA MASH pregnancy exception to ASHP general pregnancy wording.

findings.issue: Previously supported unchanged prose lost the exact source sections during rebinding.
findings.resolution: Restore NIDDK Other causes for differential; restore NIDDK Complications and EASL natural-history pp4-7 for complications overview. No redundant medical rewrite required.

findings.issue: Several lifestyle, pediatric, nutrition, monitoring and multi-clause items remain single-author-group or partly supported; splitting improved honesty but does not fill evidence.
findings.resolution: Follow individual notes; preserve accurate single-source explanations as such. Key actions/risks/thresholds/benefits must meet release evidence threshold.

findings.issue: New explanations/cautions have source-scope gaps despite broadly plausible wording.
findings.resolution: Use exact additional locator or independent authored support identified per claim; no blanket removal of useful cautions.

next_step: Author repairs explicit evidence/binding gaps; targeted recheck of changed items only. No broad re-audit of unchanged supported statements.
